command: orangecount query --semantics v3 --format typed-csv <owner ledger> "<period query>"

environment.ledger: 仓库外的所有者私有账本（路径本身不写入记录）
environment.note: 只读查询；只记录聚合行数，不记录科目名、金额、日期、路径或叙述。
sql: SELECT year(date) AS year, month(date) AS month, currency, sum(number) AS total FROM postings WHERE account ~ '^Expenses' GROUP BY year(date), month(date), currency ORDER BY year(date), month(date), currency

SELECT year(date) AS year, month(date) AS month, currency, sum(number) AS total FROM postings WHERE account ~ '^Income' GROUP BY year(date), month(date), currency ORDER BY year(date), month(date), currency
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM postings
